notes:
Topline: Mid-size clinical SaaS (201-1000 emp) building enterprise-grade RAG for clinician search across charts, consult notes, and imaging reports. Heavy PHI requirements — must run in customer VPC or on-prem; no PHI egress.

Account ownership:
- AE: Maya Patel (owner) — primary commercial contact.
- SE: Carlos Mendes — technical lead for POC and perf testing.
- CSM: Aisha Rahman — onboarding if we convert.

Background / business need:
- Goal: single search surface for clinicians to retrieve relevant passages, then run reranking to surface evidence-based answers. Replace slow internal search + manual triage.
- Scale: initial index ~20M documents (notes, imaging captions, attachments OCR). Expected growth to 60M in 12–18 months.
- Workloads: embeddings + ANN store for candidate retrieval (approx 1536-d vectors), then cross-encoder reranker for top-100 results.

Requirements & constraints (customer-provided):
- PHI controls: no external tokenization or persisted copies outside VPC; per-request audit logging and 7+ years retention for access logs.
- Network: private peering to our cloud, option to deploy on-prem appliance for certain sites.
- KMS/HSM integration: must use customer-managed keys, HSM-backed key store for encryption at rest.
- Identity: SSO/SAML + SCIM provisioning, role-based access, break-glass on-call flow.
- Compliance: SOC2 required, ISO27001 preferred; security questionnaires in progress.

Performance targets / economics:
- Latency target: P95 end-to-end (retrieve + rerank) <= 350ms for single-document queries; P99 <= 800ms.
- Throughput target: sustained 200 qps during peak, burst to 800 qps for 5–10 min windows.
- Cost sensitivity: moderate — willing to pay for deterministic latency for clinicians, but wants cost/score guidance (cost per query target <$0.020 ideally at scale).
- Reranker compute: prefer GPU-accelerated cross-encoders for latency; open to distilled CPU-friendly models for cheaper batch scoring.

Model and routing preferences:
- Prefer vetted open embeddings (on-prem friendly) over external proprietary APIs for PHI reasons.
- Want automatic fallback to lower-cost quantized variants during sustained bursts; prefer policy-based routing (region + tier + cost-latency tradeoff).

POC plan (agreed):
- Phase 0 (security): deliver network diagram + KMS/HSM integration checklist by next week. (SEC-2043)
- Phase 1 (data + infra): ingest 20M docs into a sandbox VPC; baseline ANN store (HNSW) and embedding encode on dedicated pool.
- Phase 2 (perf): run load tests for 200 qps sustained; measure retrieval + rerank latencies; profile cost per QPS.
- Phase 3 (eval): clinician UX trial with 5 hospital sites; measure accuracy/regression against golden prompts.
